title: AEDLocation
description: Where one AED (automated external defibrillator) is installed: one row of the list a municipality publishes as 自治体標準オープンデータセット dataset 08 (AED設置箇所一覧)

@context.description: JSON-LD context of the entity, optional: a context URL or a list of context URLs

nameKana.description: Name in full-width katakana (名称_カナ)

nameEn.description: Name in English (名称_英字 or 名称_英語)

externalFacilityId.description: The facility's ID in the municipality's list (ID; unique within the municipality and the dataset). Together with localGovernmentCode it identifies the facility nationwide

localGovernmentCode.description: Local government code of the municipality that publishes the list (全国地方公共団体コード, 6 digits)

address.description: Address of the facility, as a JapaneseAddress value (common subject). Its localGovernmentCode is the code of the municipality the facility lies in, which can differ from the publisher's

location.description: Where the facility is, as a point (緯度, 経度)

installationLocation.description: Where in the building or site the AED is, for example 1階事務室 (設置位置)

operatorName.description: Name of the organisation that runs the facility or, for equipment such as an AED, installed it (団体名, 法人の名称)

corporateNumber.description: Corporate number (法人番号, 13 digits, National Tax Agency) of the organisation that runs the facility or installed the equipment

contactPoint.description: How to get in touch, as a ContactPoint value (common subject): telephone, extension, fax, e-mail, web form, other channels, postal code

openingHoursSpecification.description: When the facility can be used, as an OpeningHours value (common subject): weekdays, opening and closing time, remarks

pediatricSupport.description: true when equipment for children, such as paediatric pads, is there (小児対応設備の有無: 有 → true, 無 → false)

restrictedAccess.description: true when the AED is in a restricted area and not available to the general public (外部利用不可)
